title: Standard BST Insertion with Red Color
description: Insert the new node as in a regular BST. Color the new node RED. Inserting as red preserves black-height (property 5) but may violate the no-red-red rule (property 4).

title: Check for Red-Red Violation
description: If the parent of the new node is BLACK, no violation occurs and insertion is complete. If parent is RED, a red-red conflict exists and must be resolved.

title: Identify Uncle's Color
description: Examine the color of the uncle (sibling of parent). Case A: Uncle is RED. Case B: Uncle is BLACK (or null). The uncle's color determines which fix-up strategy to apply.

title: Fix-Up: Recoloring (Uncle RED)
description: If uncle is RED: recolor parent and uncle to BLACK, and grandparent to RED. This pushes the red-red problem up to the grandparent. Recursively fix from grandparent.

title: Fix-Up: Rotation + Recoloring (Uncle BLACK)
description: If uncle is BLACK and the node forms a triangle (LR or RL): rotate parent to make a line. Then for line configuration (LL or RR): rotate grandparent and recolor. This resolves the violation locally.

title: Ensure Root is Black
description: After all fix-ups, color the root BLACK. This guarantees property 2 and may resolve the last remaining red-red violation at the root.
